educational.aim: To implement and analyze the performance of Dijkstra's Single Source Shortest Path Algorithm on weighted directed graphs using a min-heap priority queue.
system_requirements: Hardware: Intel Core i7 / 16 GB RAM
algorithm: Initialize distance array with infinity for all vertices except source vertex set to 0.
Insert (0, source) into min-heap priority queue.
While priority queue is non-empty, extract vertex with minimum distance.
For each adjacent vertex, perform relaxation: if dist[u] + weight(u, v) < dist[v], update dist[v] and push to priority queue.
Repeat until all reachable vertices are settled. Print shortest path matrix.
educational.sample_input: Graph: 5 Vertices (A, B, C, D, E), Source = 'A'
educational.result_and_inference: Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm was successfully implemented and verified with time complexity O((V + E) log V). The computed shortest path lengths matched the theoretical optimal bounds without deviation.
